name: 35963-visionprefill-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine with --distributed-executor-backend uni.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.8B params: a 27-layer vision tower (patch 16, 2x2 spatial merge) over a 36-layer decoder; the rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=8 requests/s, an operating point below saturation; bounded at 1200 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup the first 20% (240 requests). ~150 s of load.
workload: Synthetic image-heavy prefill: eight 256x256 JPEG images plus a 32-token text prompt per request, four output tokens, temperature 0.0. 256x256 is exactly the checkpoint's min_pixels and a multiple of the preprocessor's rounding factor 32, so an image is neither reshaped nor rescaled and reaches the decoder as 64 tokens; ~580 prompt tokens per request, ~91% of it picture. The images come from eight separate `synthetic_image` sources (seeds 200..207, gradient, jpeg quality 85) rather than one source with `images_per_request: 8`, which guidellm 0.7.3 turns into an eight-turn conversation of one image each.
purpose: An image-understanding assistant for product photos: eight pictures and a short question per request, eight per second, one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni

max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
enable-prefix-caching: false

# MUST MATCH scenario.json, which emits exactly eight images per request and no video. It is both
# the admission limit and what the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8, "video": 0}
